source_reference.evidence_scope: exact preserved handoff bytes; not repository-head source acceptance

runtime_representation_candidate.alpha: straight alpha candidate; confirm with Astral importer before adoption
runtime_representation_candidate.color: neutral monochrome raster with transparent background; semantic/theme tint remains runtime-owned
runtime_representation_candidate.color_space: not promoted until Astral texture/UI contract proves expected sampling
runtime_representation_candidate.mip_policy: not selected until native UI sampling is measured
runtime_representation_candidate.atlas_policy: single-image acceptance first; do not atlas before import/render behavior is proven

derivation_requirements: preserve square aspect ratio and exact symbol geometry
transparent background; no baked lighting, shadow, bevel, gradient, or semantic theme color
no nonzero-alpha pixels may touch the raster edge at review sizes
do not upscale a lower-resolution raster to create a higher-resolution accepted derivative
retain the SVG as canonical editable source even if runtime uses raster derivatives
measure Astral alpha, filtering, tint, DPI/layout scaling and atlas behavior before runtime promotion

accessibility_reference_policy.non_text_contrast: proposed runtime/theme review: meaningful icon or component-state visuals should target at least 3:1 against adjacent colors where applicable; source art alone cannot prove this
accessibility_reference_policy.target_size: glyph dimensions are not the interactive hit target; pointer/touch target acceptance belongs to the UI layout/control layer

offline_reference_raster.claim_boundary: offline source-derived technical evidence only; candidate PNGs are not committed and do not establish Astral import, runtime behavior, accessibility, performance, or art approval

reference_evidence.lesson: resolution-independent UI uses explicit DPI scaling rules, so review must cover multiple effective sizes

reference_evidence.source: Unity 6 Graphic and font assets preparation
reference_evidence.lesson: raster UI images remain recommended for UI Toolkit; preserve high-quality editable source and validate atlas/runtime behavior separately
3:1 is the relevant non-text contrast reference for meaningful UI component/state visuals; runtime theme must be tested separately
interactive target size is a control/layout property, distinct from icon glyph art size

promotion_gates.source_validated: blocked until exact SVG and expected manifest are present and independently checked on repository head
promotion_gates.raster_candidate_validated: requires an accepted derivation tool/version, exact derivative manifest and independent decode checks
promotion_gates.imported: requires an Astral-supported representation and import receipt
promotion_gates.runtime_verified: requires native Astral captures at multiple effective UI scales with alpha/filtering/tint checks
